qualification_limits: One separate board, this exact image, configured 16 MHz and 115200 baud only.
Cold evidence does not establish uninterrupted execution throughout the host wait or directly timestamp entry relative to host opening.
Pure watchdog-only reset cause 08 without EXTRF was not qualified.
Unchanged Boot under CF establishes combined software/hardware protection.
Full SREG preservation and opcode rejection have instruction-model coverage; physical probes invoke only 01/03/05.
Arduino IDE and MiniCore package overrides have not been run on this host.
Voltage, temperature, endurance and power loss during erase/write were not qualified.
